objective: test whether a fresh major flush-reversal epoch plus multiscale propagation can complement Stage 112 without loosening V18 or using volume as direction

reversal_epoch_law.flush: completed minute strict direction d with volume at least 5x and dual-book range at least 2x
reversal_epoch_law.reversal: next minute makes a same-edge extreme, one-minute direction, velocity, and acceleration all equal -d, volume at least 12x, dual-book range at least 2x, and strict direction is either -d or unresolved
reversal_epoch_law.reset: the reversal starts a new epoch and never inherits an earlier ordinary phase-front failure
reversal_epoch_law.direction: derived from dual-book price and velocity agreement only; volume has no directional vote
reversal_epoch_law.entry_clock: first qualifying completed five-minute propagation close schedules the next one-minute open

ownership_law.same_direction_v18_raw_turn: bridge remains owned; no mechanical flatten
ownership_law.same_direction_v18_maturation: transfer bridge ownership to V18 only when admitted
ownership_law.risk: existing 300 USD raw-loss cap, Friday 16:53 ET flat, roll, and data-gap laws remain unconditional
ownership_law.execution: one contract, next-open historical model, existing live accelerated LIMIT ladder only

selection_year_gate.selection: among passing cells choose the count-plateau medoid, then higher selection-year PnL/DD, then lower drawdown, then fewer degrees of freedom

locked_challenge_gate.known_incident_captured: the selected cell must schedule the 2026-08-06 UP bridge no later than the 05:45 close / 05:46 next open
locked_challenge_gate.known_false_start_rejected: the 2026-08-06 01:25 UP impulse must remain unadmitted because no major-shock reversal epoch exists
